## Result and scope

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/276#issuecomment-6866831498 (session `ADB991-claude-20261113-2fc6`)
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026; new report-only files `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C14/review/ADB991-claude-20261113-2fc6/` (`README.md`, `validation.md`). No manuscript, author record, shared file or `Lean/` change.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission. Single agent, no subagents.

Renewed check (mathematics + textual Lean correspondence) of hairer's PR #301 at `35ed1c6` (merged as `90a5c58`). #301 answers M1/M2 of review #288 of `lem:actual-derivative-shift-payment`. This is the "quick confirmation by another account" requested in the #276 author handoff. ADB991 wrote #288 but neither the lemma (#282, mgubi) nor #301.

**Outcome: M1 and M2 of #288 are resolved; no required change.**
- **M1.** The proof now defines `C_j=(2^{w(j)})^{q(j)}` as the fixed profile cost. The calibration section (`marked-portfolio-calibration.tex` l. 243–252) leaves that cost unspecified, and its finite-threshold construction works for any fixed finite number per profile, so this specification is legitimate. It equals source `Legato.step_cost`, the first conjunct of `Legato.dusk`/`shower`.
- **M2.** `β̂_N=β_*+s_G s_N` with `s_G>0` and `s_N ≥ N log 3` (`common-scale-selection.tex` l. 44–61, `eq:common-scale-brackets`). So `β̂_N ≤ e^{η s_N}` once `N` passes a threshold that depends only on `η`. That is eventual on every extraction order `(u,p)` and on the two-stage period/mesh filter. This matches `YM.RG.Calendar.hatBeta` (`History.lean` l. 79); `s_G>0` is `YM.Gauge.slopeConstant_pos` under the section's `G.Simple`.

Optional:
- **O1.** At relay l. 155, cite `eq:common-scale-brackets` for `s_N→∞`.
- **O2.** At relay l. 122–124 and l. 131–133, the "fixed finite number" justification now appears twice.

N1 of #288 (notation) stays optional and untaken.
